SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL PATIENT
Discharge instructions

Take Lisinopril 10 mg by mouth once a day for 14 days.

Follow up within 7 days.
Call for chest pain, fainting, or swelling of the face.

Medication reconciliation note

Continue Lisinopril 20 mg by mouth once a day for 14 days.
The differing dose entries require reviewer confirmation.
